agent_note: AGENT: This file is generated for the user to read. Do not read, parse or edit it: use python3 pm/pm.py list|json and python3 pm/question.py open|show.

TODO.md.title: TODO
intro: Decided tasks that are not started yet, by area and topic. **Next up** lists the first ready tasks in priority order.
Status: **ready** = can start, **waiting** = waits for your answer to a question, **blocked** = waits for another task.

WIP.md.title: Work in progress
intro: Tasks being worked on now. The last dated **Status** line of each task says where the work stands.

DONE.md.title: Done
intro: Finished tasks, each with its **Result** (what was verified and how) and any **Not done** scope.

BACKLOG.md.title: Backlog
intro: Ideas and later improvements that are not decided yet. Tell the agent which ones to move to TODO.

DROPPED.md.title: Dropped
intro: Rejected or obsolete tasks, kept with the reason so the history survives.

ALL_TASKS.md.title: All tasks
intro: Every task in every state, by area (N) and topic (N.M); N.0 holds tasks that concern a whole area. Within a topic: in progress first, then todo, backlog, done and dropped.

QUESTIONS_OPEN.md.title: Open questions
intro: Questions waiting for your answer, oldest first. Answer by ID and option, e.g. "Q-0012: a" or "Q-0012: b, but ...". The recommended option is listed first.

QUESTIONS_CLOSED.md.title: Answered questions
intro: Answered questions, newest first, with every answer and its time.

SPEC.md.title: Specification
intro: The requirements of the project. **Committed** requirements are agreed and locked: they change only through a change request (ECR) that you approve. **Draft** requirements may still change.
Open change requests are listed at the end with the tasks they affect.

labels.no_tasks_no_areas: No tasks and no areas yet.
labels.summary_caption: Counts of todo and in-progress tasks by status, then backlog, done and dropped.
labels.meta_task: Meta task (done when the tasks it depends on are done)
labels.waiting_items: Also waiting for you (asked in chat)
labels.suspect: Suspect: a requirement it refines has changed; to be reviewed
labels.spec_sealed: Sealed requirements (only the user changes them, by hand)
